answer: Attention-Entropy Registry. Each identity must periodically submit a fixed number of unpredictable micro-tasks, timed like a lantern flickering at random intervals, so no script can precompute responses. A zephyr of new identities is throttled because each one must independently accumulate a rolling history of timely, non-repetitive answers before gaining full weight. The enforcement rule: weight scales with sustained low-entropy response diversity across epochs.
